name: accounting_constraints
preconditionSql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.schema_migrations WHERE version = '0018') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'pk_gl_accounts') AS ok;
verificationSql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'pk_gl_accounts' AND contype = 'p') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'uq_gl_accounts__company_code' AND contype = 'u') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'pk_journal_entries' AND contype = 'p') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'pk_journal_lines' AND contype = 'p') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'fk_journal_entries__posting_batch' AND contype = 'f') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'fk_journal_entries__reversal_entry' AND contype = 'f') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'fk_journal_lines__gl_account' AND contype = 'f') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'fk_finance_categories__gl_account' AND contype = 'f') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'ck_journal_lines__debit_nonnegative' AND contype = 'c') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'ck_journal_lines__credit_nonnegative' AND contype = 'c') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'ck_journal_lines__single_side' AND contype = 'c') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger t JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relname='journal_lines' AND t.tgname='ct_journal_entries__balanced_at_commit' AND t.tgdeferrable AND t.tginitdeferred AND NOT t.tgisinternal) AS ok;
recovery: Transactional failure rolls the Accounting constraint migration back. After successful production apply, recovery is forward-only: preserve posted journal/accounting history and issue a reviewed corrective migration rather than dropping integrity constraints or rewriting committed migration history. The existing COMMIT-time deferred journal-balance trigger remains authoritative for full-entry balance. Independent Accounting indexes remain Phase 03.07. Posting creation, reversal/correction, source validation and accounting business rules remain later backend transaction responsibilities.
